info.name: First Material for Building a New House
info.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.

descriptions.notStarted: Let's go meet Ronnie in the woods in Ellinia.
descriptions.inProgress: Ronnie from the forest of Ellinia asked me a favor of gathering up materials to build a house for the newborn fairies that are to come down the road. #b50 of orange mushroom caps, leaves, squishy liquid, and red snail shells each#k ... I guess I can get most of these from the monsters around the prairie ...
descriptions.completed: I got all the items Ronnie requested, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??
